title: Dentika

seo.title: Dentika — Custom Web & CRM Development Case Study | Circles
seo.description: A fully custom digital ecosystem for Dentika: public website, proprietary dental CRM, product design, UX/UI, and full-stack development.

jsonLdDescription: A fully custom digital ecosystem for Dentika, combining a high-performance public website with a proprietary CRM designed around the daily reality of modern dental clinics.
workPageTitle: A complete digital product built from the ground up: Dentika’s public website and proprietary CRM, designed and developed as one connected system.
servicesValue: Custom Web · Custom CRM · Full Stack
imageAlt: Dentika custom website and proprietary dental platform

showcase.heroDescription: A complete digital ecosystem, designed and developed from the ground up: public experience, clinical operations, and business intelligence in one connected product.
showcase.problemTitle: Care was connected. The tools were not.
showcase.problemBody: Appointments lived in one place, patient context in another, and business decisions depended on fragmented reports. The clinic needed less software noise and more operational clarity.
showcase.solutionTitle: One custom-built ecosystem, inside and out.
showcase.solutionBody: We designed and developed the public website and the proprietary CRM as one product: a clear brand experience for patients and a powerful operating layer for the team.
showcase.systemTitle: Every essential workflow. One visual language.
showcase.systemBody: A modular product system connects front desk, clinical work, patient relationships, and management without losing depth or human clarity.
showcase.agendaBody: Dynamic scheduling that makes chair availability, confirmations, and the day’s priorities instantly legible.
showcase.patientsBody: A complete relationship history designed for fast retrieval, better follow-up, and more personal care.
showcase.odontogramBody: Clinical precision translated into a visual record that is fast to update and easy to understand.
showcase.insightsBody: Real-time indicators turn everyday activity into clear decisions for a healthier, more productive clinic.
showcase.recordsBody: Treatments, notes, documents, and patient history brought together in one precise longitudinal view.
showcase.settingsBody: Roles, rooms, services, notifications, and clinic rules configured without adding operational complexity.
showcase.experienceTitle: The public experience is part of the product.
showcase.experienceBody: A fast, responsive website translates Dentika’s clinical precision into a clear patient journey—from discovery and treatments to trust and conversion.
showcase.responsiveTitle: The clinic in motion, without compromise.
showcase.responsiveBody: The proprietary CRM adapts to each context: an operational command center on MacBook Pro, fast patient actions on iPhone, and a spacious clinical agenda on iPad Air.
showcase.outcomeTitle: Less operational friction. More time for care.
showcase.outcomeBody: Dentika is positioned as a fully custom digital product—not a template and not just a CRM. Brand, frontend, product design, clinical workflows, and full-stack engineering work as one system.
showcase.finalTitle: Custom built, from the first click to the last clinical detail.
